The full pet deposit was refunded today.
I am considering a Honda Civic for my next car.
I decided against the Civic because it felt too small.
I bought a used 2022 Ford Escape today.
I stopped ordering cappuccinos and drink espresso now.
I moved from Seattle to Tacoma last year and still live in Tacoma.
My coworker Priya Nair is reviewing the Orion proposal with me.
Avery ordered a double espresso.
